prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 26 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1115; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical whiplash injury. The mechanism of injury described is plausible for a collision of this type. Over the course of 26 visits, care included conservative management with manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching program instruction. Cervical imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury, with reduced range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness documented at initial evaluation. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical spine is known. The treatment course followed a typical progression, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward normal. Billing records reflect one charge per scheduled service, with no duplicate or repeated entries. At discharge, the patient was improving, with residual mild stiffness and a plan for independent home exercise.
